provenance.relationship: The catalog rescue, strict recovered bundle, and historical repository source are independent identities. No byte-equivalence claim is made between them. The strict recovered deployment defines the compatibility contract.

bindings.DEDUP_KV: scoped PostgreSQL dedup_kv table; shared archive import is fail-closed without an owned-key rule
bindings.R2_RECORDS: historical object archive was absent; new page documents use a dedicated MinIO service identity, isolated output bucket, deterministic keys, live lease fencing, and full-body digest verification
bindings.SCRAPE_QUEUE: PostgreSQL leased queue with idempotency, retry, lease recovery, and dead-letter state
bindings.RELAY_URL: loopback-only ShadowGlass Master plus exact-origin allowlist; never caller-controlled

endpoint_state.activation_gate: all seven active endpoints pass a live provider-family verification before import

runtime.public_edge_delta: No custom domain is attached, but the legacy workers.dev endpoint is active. Cutover disables that endpoint only after staging, production, and rollback gates pass; no replacement public hostname is created.

release_gate.identity: clean Git HEAD plus commit tree and deterministic git-archive source digest
release_gate.staging: release-scoped disposable PostgreSQL database, MinIO bucket, credentials, API smoke, endpoint semantics, consumer canary, and scheduler proof
release_gate.finalization: release-bound ordered evidence digests, fresh endpoint/API/consumer/scheduler attestation, exact D1/KV rescued-subset verification, and installed-unit byte equality
release_gate.production_provisioning: monotonic idempotent schema/role/credential provisioning followed by an exact D1/KV/endpoint compatibility recheck before promotion

intentional_security_deltas: Only /health is unauthenticated; every dashboard, read, scrape, queue-control, and probe route requires a scoped credential.
The direct scrape route is durable-queue backed rather than bypassing retries and idempotency.
The legacy public relay is replaced by loopback-only ShadowGlass Master validation; caller-selected relay destinations are impossible.
The six declared but unreferenced secret bindings are removed instead of resurrected.
No replacement public hostname or tunnel route is created without live compatibility evidence; the discovered legacy workers.dev edge is disabled during reversible cutover.
Historical R2 object bytes were not present in the rescue archive; no HTTP route serves those objects, while new page documents are persisted in isolated MinIO.
Only seven current official county portals with verified supported adapters are active; eleven retired or unsupported portals fail closed as inactive.
